name: No guaranteed-approval claims
description: Marketing copy must not promise or imply that approval is certain.
snippetText: Remove guaranteed-approval language. Approval depends on credit review.

name: Rate shown requires APR
description: If a rate or interest percentage is shown, the APR must appear alongside it.

detection.trigger: a percentage near the word 'rate' or 'interest'

snippetText: Rate is shown without APR. Add the APR alongside it.

name: Equal Housing Lender statement
description: Mortgage marketing must include the Equal Housing Lender statement.
snippetText: Add the Equal Housing Lender statement.

name: "Prequalified" must not imply final approval
description: Prequalification language must not read as a final credit decision.
snippetText: Use 'prequalify' wording. This isn't a final approval.

name: Credit approval disclaimer
description: Loan and card offers must state that they are subject to credit approval.

name: No pressure or false urgency
description: Urgency language is only acceptable when the actual offer end date is stated.
snippetText: Remove urgency language or state the actual offer end date.

name: Disclosure reachable in short formats
description: Short formats must point to the full terms.

required: link or reference to full terms

snippetText: Add 'terms apply' with a link to full disclosures.
